All three test classes compiled successfully:

- `tests/org/apache/commons/lang3/reflect/MemberUtilsAgentTest.java` — covers `isPublic`/`isStatic`/`isAccessible`/`isPackage` (including null and modifier boundary cases), `isMatchingMethod`/`isMatchingConstructor`, `compareMethodFit`/`compareConstructorFit` ordering, and `setAccessibleWorkaround`.
- `tests/org/apache/commons/lang3/reflect/ConstructorUtilsAgentTest.java` — covers both `getAccessibleConstructor` overloads, `getMatchingAccessibleConstructor`, both `invokeConstructor` and `invokeExactConstructor` overloads, plus `NullPointerException`, `NoSuchMethodException`, `InstantiationException`, `InvocationTargetException`, and `IllegalArgumentException` boundary cases.
- `tests/org/apache/commons/lang3/reflect/MethodUtilsAgentTest.java` — covers all `getAccessibleMethod`/`getAnnotation`/`getMatchingAccessibleMethod`/`getMatchingMethod`/`getMethodObject`/`getMethodsWithAnnotation`/`getMethodsListWithAnnotation`/`getOverrideHierarchy` methods and all `invoke*Method`/`invoke*StaticMethod` overloads (exact vs. compatible matching, forced access, varargs), with null and ambiguity error cases.

Each file is self-contained with its own nested fixtures, uses only Java 8-compatible syntax (no diamond operator, lambdas, or underscored literals), and `./compile.sh` reports `compiled OK`.
